hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r .command 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "(rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+push\s+-f|curl.*\|.*bash|wget.*\|.*bash|dd\s+if.*of=.*/dev/|mkfs|fdisk|parted|shred)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command pattern detected: $cmd" >&2; exit 1; fi'

bash -c 'file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r .filePath 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ -z "$file" ]; then file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r .path 2>/dev/null || echo ""); fi; if [ -n "$file" ]; then ext="${file##*.}"; case "$ext" in ts|tsx|js|jsx) npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; py) ruff format "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; go) gofmt -w "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; rs) rustfmt "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; fi'
